sender: Shibuya City Office, National Health Insurance Division (渋谷区 区民部 国民健康保険課)
summary: This is your National Health Insurance premium notice for fiscal year 2026. The yearly premium is 87,000 yen, paid in 10 instalments of 8,700 yen from June 2026 to March 2027.

actions.title: Pay health insurance premium, instalment 1 of 10
how: Pay with the enclosed payment slip at a bank, convenience store, or the city office counter
Or pay with a smartphone payment app, or set up automatic bank debit

consequences.text: If you fall behind on payments, you may get an insurance certificate valid for a shorter period, or you may have to pay the full medical cost first.

warnings: If your income is low, the premium may be reduced. If you have not declared last year's income, declare it at the city office.
